changelog: v1.3.8.8: Added manual Blocklist entry form in Web UI and backend POST /Blocklist endpoint with aligned styling. Implemented filename vs DBID verification guard on Exclude & Remove to preserve legitimate DBIDs while protecting against erroneous metadata auto-identifications. Implemented GetAllMovieItems direct SQLite deletion in PurgeAllStrm, added history tracking and lifecycle cleanup to direct downloads, isolated year-specific language cache lookups, and qualified System.IO.File calls.
description: Native Downloads ecosystem for Jellyfin. Scrapes external forums for new media and integrates with Seedr and Torbox for downloading.
name: JellyFetch
overview: External media scraper and download manager. Integrates Seedr and Torbox.
